Kaṇakasiṃha

Kaṇagasattari

Kaṇāda

Kaṇāda

Kaṇāda

Kaṇāda_Tarkavāgīśa

--Apaśabdakhaṇḍana. B. IV. 12. Baroda 4126. BORI. 173 of 1895-98. BORI. D. II. i. 425. Peters. VI. p. 74 (no. 173). a. given wrongly in some a. Śrīkaṇa, Kaṇokta an. Kāṇāda Muni.
[--Avayavaṭippaṇī, C. on the Avayava, part of Anumānacintāmaṇi.
See below under his Tattvacintāmaṇivyākhyā].
--Tattvacintāmaṇivyākhyā. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 5 [no. 785] (Anumāna). C.. III. 582 (Avayava, part of Anumāna). Hpr. I. 14 (Avayava). L. 1601 (Anumāna).
--Bhāṣāratna. vaiś. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 83 (no. 1760). Cuttack 105. L. 119. 1532. Vaṅgīya p. 249.
--Vāyuvāda. vaiś. Rep. Hpr. 1901-6. p. 17.

Kaṇādanyāyabhūṣaṇa

Kaṇādasaṃhitā

The Nāḍīparīkṣā of Kaṇāda has been in print, having been ptd. twice in Calcutta an. once in Bombay.
